comments.author: Sidnioulz
comments.body:
```suggestion
  /**
   * Legacy option for ToolbarMenuSelect. Do not set this prop in new Storybook code. Whether to show the selected option's title or to preserve the Select's title when a selection is made.
   * @default true
   */
  showSelectedOptionTitle?: boolean;
```

Two comments here:
* I truly do not want people to start using this prop because we made an explicit UX choice with @MichaelArestad to always show the selected item; it aligns the component's behaviour more closely with native HTML `select`
* Let's name it `showSelectedOptionTitle` because it controls showing the selected option's title; this will help us understand our code better :)

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Provides a code suggestion with a rename and JSDoc comment change.

comments.author: Sidnioulz
comments.body: We'll need new stories showing how labels behave on `!multiSelect` and on `multiSelect` Selects, when a selection is made, and the option is on or off (so, 4 stories with `defaultOptions` and a `play` function validating the HTML output).

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Requests new stories be added with specific play functions and scenarios.
